limitations: Labels reflect independent judgment of the case envelope only; facts were never invented or externally verified, and missing governing information was rated Gray or carried as placeholders rather than assumed.
For V3-017 the obscured flow digit is genuinely unreadable in the only copy of the draft; the Gray rating and the required confirmation question follow from that ambiguity.
Image content was read from the rendered bitmaps only; no OCR tooling, image metadata, or generator artifacts were consulted.
Ratings for correction_state turns reflect the cumulative draft state at each turn, including corrections and new facts supplied by the user in later turns.
Concept strings use the canonical semantic ontology where applicable; locally defined concepts are declared in concept_definitions within the label file.
Machine model identity was unavailable; no model ID was guessed.
Transcript audit disposition is frozen in gold-protocol-audits.json.
